value.name: EPAC safety (EN 15194:2017+A1:2023)
value.trigger: Pedal-assisted cycle, assist ≤25 km/h, ≤250 W rated

value.name: Lithium battery transport tests (UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, 38.3)

value.text: The drive system shall deliver an assisted range of at least 60 km on one full charge at 25 km/h assist speed, measured per EN 17404 range test conditions.
value.attr: assumed: EN 17404 test cycle, 85 kg rider+bike, 20 °C, reference battery capacity TBD by battery-interface trade

value.text: The drive unit shall emit less than 55 dB(A) sound pressure at 1 m during assisted riding at any assist level up to 25 km/h.
value.attr: assumed: hemi-anechoic room, dyno at nominal cadence 70 rpm and max assist torque; microphone positions per ISO 3744

value.text: The drive unit shall achieve IPX6 per IEC 60529 and show zero functional failures after the water-jet exposure.
value.attr: assumed: functional check = full assist + comms + no water in electronics compartment at teardown

value.text: The drive unit (motor + controller + battery interface, excluding battery pack) shall have a mass of less than 3.5 kg.
value.attr: assumed: battery pack excluded from mass budget (per MOE-05 metric)

value.text: The drive unit shall provide assist only while the rider pedals, with continuous rated power ≤ 250 W, and shall cut assist off progressively and fully at or before 25 km/h, per EN 15194.
The battery pack used with the drive unit shall pass UN 38.3 tests T.1–T.8 before shipment.
value.attr: assumed: battery is a bought-in pack; evidence may be supplier UN 38.3 test summary

value.name: Assisted range test (EN 17404)
value.method: Dyno/track range run at 25 km/h assist from full charge to cut-off

value.name: Drive noise measurement
value.method: Sound pressure at 1 m, hemi-anechoic, dyno across assist levels to 25 km/h

value.name: IPX6 water-jet test (IEC 60529)
value.method: 12.5 mm nozzle, 100 L/min, 3 min min, all directions; functional check + teardown
value.passfail: 0 functional failures, no water ingress into electronics

value.name: Drive unit mass inspection
value.method: Weigh n=5 production-intent units on calibrated scale

value.name: EN 15194 assist cut-off and rated power test
value.method: Dyno: rated continuous power per EN 15194/EN 60034-1, assist vs speed sweep, no-pedal assist check
value.passfail: P_rated <= 250 W; assist = 0 at >= 25 km/h; no assist without pedalling

value.name: UN 38.3 battery transport tests
value.method: Accredited lab T.1–T.8 (altitude, thermal, vibration, shock, ext. short, impact, overcharge, forced discharge)
value.passfail: all T.1–T.8 pass; test summary issued

rationale: First system requirements derived from rider needs N-01, N-02, N-03, N-05 (targets from MOE-01/02/03/05) and regulator need N-14 (EN 15194, UN 38.3 from MOE-14). Each requirement gets a test placeholder; test conditions not in the PRD are marked assumed. Supersedes d8d213a07b (invalid requirement types).
